Extract all images from a document into metadata

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<html><head><title>Gallery</title></head><body><img src="https://example.com/photo1.jpg" alt="Photo 1"><img src="https://example.com/photo2.png" alt="Photo 2"><img src="/local/image.webp" alt="Local image"></body></html>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.images.inspect
```
